|translation='''Title:''' Reserve Pilot.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 1 to the power of any starship he pilots. If aboard Black 2, Black 3, or Black 4, also adds 1 to maneuver and may draw 1 battle destiny if otherwise unable.

'''Lore:'''
An elite TIE pilot under Vader who left the front line because of combat injuries. He waits as a replacement and can take the place of a dead or wounded pilot at any time.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says he left the front line from combat injuries and can replace dead or wounded pilots.
